lures.name: Brass Spinner
lures.desc: Heavy brass. Only the big ones bother with it.

lures.name: Paper Moth
lures.desc: A paper moth on a hook. It flutters when nobody is watching.

lures.name: Tin Minnow
lures.desc: Somebody loved this once. The paint is worn away where a thumb would go.

wearables.name: Tarred Boots
wearables.desc: You stand a little firmer than the fish expects.

wearables.name: Gull Feather
wearables.desc: It points at the float just before it goes under. Mostly.

wearables.name: The Keeper's Sou'wester
wearables.desc: The brim is stiff with twelve winters of salt. It fits.

wearables.name: The Keeper's Oilskin
wearables.blurb: Fish sell for 8% more, 4 more hold slots
wearables.desc: A list in the pocket, in a careful hand: the names of fish. Some are crossed out.

wearables.name: The Keeper's Boots
wearables.desc: Left side by side above the tide line, toes to the sea.

wearables.name: The Keeper's Whistle
wearables.blurb: A longer moment to hook, stranger fish
wearables.desc: Blow it and nothing sounds. Something out past the Teeth turns to listen anyway.

bonuses.blurb: Rarer fish, and Rhythm builds two stacks higher

collections.name: The Hearthbay page
collections.text: Every Hearthbay fish, drawn and named. Wick presses something heavy and yellow into your arms.
